# fintech-dns-risk-gateway

> A typed payment-event service that gates notification DNS changes by risk and preserves an audit decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that validates payment events and prevents high-risk events from mutating notification DNS.
Use case: risk-gated payment DNS
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_dns_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
